Nodes.Speaker: tsugumi
Nodes.Text: Ah. You came. Good — I was beginning to think the mountain had swallowed you too.

Nodes.Speaker: tsugumi
Nodes.Text: Look up, Warden. The Spirit Lantern on Hinoyama has gone dark. Three nights now.

Nodes.Speaker: tsugumi
Nodes.Text: Without its light the departed cannot find the far shore. They wander. They sour. We call them the Hollowed.

Choices.Text: Who would put out the Lantern?

Nodes.Speaker: tsugumi
Nodes.Text: Not 'who' — 'what'. A mask with nothing behind it. The old songs call it Yomikage. It shattered the Lantern into three Ember Cores and scattered them across the valley.

Nodes.Speaker: tsugumi
Nodes.Text: First, show these old eyes you remember your training. The dummies by the east wall won't hit back... much. Take this bow as well — a Warden should carry two weapons.

Nodes.Speaker: tsugumi
Nodes.Text: The training ground is past the well, by the east wall. Show me your form, Warden.

Nodes.Speaker: tsugumi
Nodes.Text: Hm! Sloppy footwork, but your blade knows where it's going. That will do.

Nodes.Speaker: tsugumi
Nodes.Text: Ash has been falling on Sasagiri Bamboo Grove, through the north gate. Where there is ash there is fire, and where there is fire this season... there is a Core.

Nodes.Speaker: tsugumi
Nodes.Text: Take these dango. And visit Kanetsugu at the forge and Ohana at the tea house before you go. A Warden who travels alone travels badly.

Nodes.Speaker: tsugumi
Nodes.Text: The bamboo grove lies through the north gate. Be careful — the imps hunt in packs, and something larger commands them.

Nodes.Speaker: tsugumi
Nodes.Text: The Ember Core of Ash... I can feel its warmth from here. You've done well, Warden.

Nodes.Speaker: tsugumi
Nodes.Text: And a fox spirit at your heels? Kohaku, you old rascal. Keep the Warden alive.

Nodes.Speaker: kohaku
Nodes.Text: Hmph. The Warden keeps ME alive. Mostly.

Nodes.Speaker: tsugumi
Nodes.Text: The second Core sank beneath Mistfen Marsh. Ibuki the ferryman will know where. The east gate is open to you now.

Nodes.Speaker: tsugumi
Nodes.Text: Mistfen lies beyond the east gate. Ibuki keeps the ferry there — find him before the mist finds you.

Nodes.Speaker: tsugumi
Nodes.Text: Two Cores. Listen — the Lantern's frame already hums with them.

Nodes.Speaker: tsugumi
Nodes.Text: Only the last remains, and Yomikage holds it close. At the summit, where the Lantern once burned.

Nodes.Speaker: tsugumi
Nodes.Text: Visit Mikoto at the shrine before you climb. The summit path opens only to those she has blessed.

Nodes.Speaker: tsugumi
Nodes.Text: The summit path begins behind the shrine. Go with Mikoto's blessing, and come back to us.

Nodes.Speaker: tsugumi
Nodes.Text: The Lantern burns again, and every soul in the valley can find its way. Rest a while, Warden. You have earned it.

Nodes.Speaker: kanetsugu
Nodes.Text: Steel doesn't sharpen itself. What do you need?

Nodes.Speaker: kanetsugu
Nodes.Text: Ore. Spirit Ore. The Hollowed hoard it like magpies. Bring me five pieces and I'll make it worth your while.

Nodes.Speaker: kanetsugu
Nodes.Text: Five Spirit Ore. The Hollowed drop it when they fall. Want me to look at your gear while you're here?

Nodes.Speaker: kanetsugu
Nodes.Text: Five pieces, and good ones! Here — a naginata I've been tinkering with. Long reach, for a Warden who likes a little distance.

Nodes.Speaker: ohana
Nodes.Text: Welcome to the Fallen Leaf! Something warm for the road, Warden?

Nodes.Speaker: ohana
Nodes.Text: Ember wisps keep drifting into my tea terraces and scorching the leaves! Snuff out five of the little menaces and I'll pay you handsomely.

Nodes.Speaker: ohana
Nodes.Text: Heading to the marsh? Would you take this to Ibuki? He's kept that ferry since my grandmother's time. Never says thank you, but he drinks every last leaf.

Nodes.Speaker: ohana
Nodes.Text: The terraces are safe! Here's your bounty — and a little something to keep your spirit up.

Nodes.Speaker: ohana
Nodes.Text: Come back any time. First cup is always on the house for Wardens. Second cup is double.

Nodes.Speaker: mikoto
Nodes.Text: The shrine is quiet today. Would you like to train, or rest a while?

Nodes.Speaker: mikoto
Nodes.Text: Your wounds are mended, and the shrine will remember this moment. The Hollowed you laid to rest have... stirred again, I am afraid.

Nodes.Speaker: mikoto
Nodes.Text: A child spirit, Hotaru, never came to the shrine to cross over. Her bell was last heard among the bamboo. Would you find her?

Nodes.Speaker: mikoto
Nodes.Text: The stone sentinels in the marsh once guarded this very shrine. Now they guard nothing but rage. Will you lay three of them to rest?

Nodes.Speaker: mikoto
Nodes.Text: Her bell... and it's ringing so softly. Then she's on her way home.

Nodes.Speaker: mikoto
Nodes.Text: Thank you, Warden. Please, take this fox charm. She would want you to have something quick and clever.

Nodes.Speaker: mikoto
Nodes.Text: I felt them go quiet, one by one. They can rest now. Take these — the essence of the old guardians should strengthen your gear.

Nodes.Speaker: mikoto
Nodes.Text: So it's time. Kneel, Warden.

Nodes.Speaker: mikoto
Nodes.Text: By ember and by lantern-light, may the path keep you, and may the dark forget your name.

Nodes.Speaker: mikoto
Nodes.Text: The summit path behind the shrine is open. Whatever waits for you up there... come back down.

Nodes.Speaker: ibuki
Nodes.Text: Hm? A Warden. Haven't seen one this deep in the mist in forty years.

Nodes.Speaker: ibuki
Nodes.Text: The catacomb doors are sealed by the three braziers of the old priests. Light them and the doors will remember how to open.

Nodes.Speaker: ibuki
Nodes.Text: The braziers stand on the rises to the north, east and south of here. Mind the lurkers. They bite.

Nodes.Speaker: ibuki
Nodes.Text: Is that... Ohana's tea? Hmph. Tell her the leaves are adequate.

Nodes.Speaker: ibuki
Nodes.Text: ...Tell her thank you. And take this. A crane charm. It never tires. Like me.

Nodes.Speaker: ibuki
Nodes.Text: The mist is thick today. It's always thick.

Nodes.Speaker: hotaru
Nodes.Text: You can see me? Nobody can see me anymore...

Nodes.Speaker: hotaru
Nodes.Text: I followed the fireflies and got lost, and then the imps came, and I hid and hid and hid.

Choices.Text: Mikoto is waiting for you at the shrine.

Nodes.Speaker: hotaru
Nodes.Text: The shrine lady? She gives me sweets. Can you bring her my bell? Then she'll know I'm going home.

Nodes.Speaker: hotaru
Nodes.Text: Have you seen the fireflies? They went that way... or that way...

Nodes.Speaker: kohaku
Nodes.Text: Psst! Warden! Get rid of those imps and get me out of this cage!

Nodes.Speaker: kohaku
Nodes.Text: Finally! Do you know how long I have been in that cage? Three days. THREE.

Nodes.Speaker: kohaku
Nodes.Text: Those imps thought a fox spirit would make a fine lantern. Rude.

Nodes.Speaker: kohaku
Nodes.Text: You're the new Warden? Then you're going after the Iron-Gate Oni. I'm coming with you. Don't argue — I bite harder than I look.

Nodes.Speaker: farmer
Nodes.Text: Ash on the wind again. My rice will taste of smoke this year — if the Hollowed leave any of it.

Nodes.Speaker: farmer
Nodes.Text: Smell that? Clean air. I may even plant the east terrace again. Thank you, Warden.

Nodes.Speaker: child
Nodes.Text: Are you really a Warden? Can I hold your sword?

Nodes.Speaker: child
Nodes.Text: Fine. But when I'm a Warden I'm getting a BIGGER lantern.

Nodes.Speaker: child
Nodes.Text: I saw it! The whole mountain lit up! I'm going to be a Warden. Definitely. Probably.

Nodes.Speaker: fisher
Nodes.Text: Three nights without the Lantern. The fish won't bite, and the dead won't rest. Bad omens, both.

Nodes.Speaker: fisher
Nodes.Text: The fish are biting again. And last night I dreamed of my wife, smiling, on the far shore. Good omens, both.

Nodes.Speaker: kohaku
Nodes.Text: What? I'm resting my eyes. I can still smell the Hollowed coming.

Intro: A hundred years I have guarded it. I will guard it a hundred more — with your bones for the bolt!
Phase: You sting like a hornet, little Warden. Then I will stop holding back!

Intro: A little moth, fluttering into my web.
Come closer, Warden. I have so many threads to spare.
Phase: You tear my silk? Then I will weave you into the dark!

Intro: Light is a lie told to the dead.
I hold them here, where nothing ever ends. Put down your little flame, Warden.
Phase: You would burn it all again? Every goodbye, every ending?
BossLines.Defeat: ...so bright... I had forgotten how bright...

Ending.Text: The three Ember Cores rise from your hands and settle into the Lantern's frame.
The Spirit Lantern flares to life, and its light spills down Hinoyama like water.
In the bamboo, in the marsh, in the deep catacombs, the Hollowed pause... and remember who they were.
One by one, they turn toward the light, and cross to the far shore.

Ending.Speaker: kohaku
Ending.Text: Not bad, Warden. Not bad at all.
